method: Static analysis of production HTML and ESM imports (es-module-lexer). Roots: script src, modulepreload, Astro hydrated component and renderer URLs, plus inline executable scripts. Recursively follow static imports; list direct dynamic imports separately. Includes idle islands; excludes images, CSS, fonts, interaction/route-triggered dynamic imports and workers not explicitly preloaded. Each resource gzip-compressed independently. This is a dependency budget, NOT observed network traffic or an LCP benchmark. Feature differences are documented in REPORT.md.
